output.notes: I describe the base Code Llama model; the paper presents it as a Llama 2 fine-tune. The paper restates no architectural sizes or flavours. Values marked inherited come from Llama 2, under the declaration that the models are initialized with Llama 2 weights. Those values (sizes, RMSNorm, pre-norm, SwiGLU, no biases, untied head) are Llama 2's published architecture and are not printed anywhere in this paper. vocab_size is left not_stated: the tokenizer is Llama 2's plus 4 special tokens for the infilling models, but the base vocabulary size is never given. norm_eps is not stated. The context of 16384 is the LCFT sequence length; the initial code training used 4096. rope_theta is the post-LCFT value of 1e6, raised from Llama 2's 1e4. The RoPE pairing is read from the block-diagonal 2x2 matrix formula, i.e. adjacent pairs.
